content.json:
# IoT Monitoring

Azure IoT Hub observability: device connectivity, message throughput, device twin activity, routing health, and D2C/C2D latency.

content.query:
// Device connectivity status – connect/disconnect events from IoT Hub diagnostics
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DEVICES' and Category == 'Connections'
| extend DeviceId = tostring(deviceId_s)
| summarize
    Connects    = countif(operationName_s == 'deviceConnect'),
    Disconnects = countif(operationName_s == 'deviceDisconnect'),
    LastEvent   = max(TimeGenerated)
    by DeviceId, Resource
| extend Status = iif(Connects > Disconnects, 'Connected', 'Disconnected')
| order by LastEvent desc
| project DeviceId, Resource, Connects, Disconnects, Status, LastEvent
content.title: Device Connectivity Status

content.query:
// Device connection/disconnection trend over time
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DEVICES' and Category == 'Connections'
| summarize
    Connects    = countif(operationName_s == 'deviceConnect'),
    Disconnects = countif(operationName_s == 'deviceDisconnect')
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Connection / Disconnection Trend

content.query:
// Message throughput – total and per-device from AzureMetrics
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DEVICES'
| where MetricName in ('d2c.telemetry.ingress.success', 'd2c.telemetry.ingress.allProtocol')
| summarize TotalMessages = sum(Total) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), MetricName, Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: D2C Message Ingress Over Time

content.query:
// Per-device message volume (top senders)
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DEVICES' and Category == 'D2CTwinOperations' or Category == 'DeviceTelemetry'
| extend DeviceId = tostring(deviceId_s)
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| summarize MessageCount = count() by DeviceId, Resource
| top 20 by MessageCount desc
| project DeviceId, IoTHub = Resource, MessageCount
content.title: Top 20 Devices by Message Volume

content.query:
// Device twin update activity
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DEVICES' and Category == 'D2CTwinOperations'
| extend DeviceId = tostring(deviceId_s)
| summarize
    UpdateCount = count(),
    Successes   = countif(Level == 'Information'),
    Failures    = countif(Level == 'Error')
    by DeviceId, operationName_s, Resource
| order by UpdateCount desc
| top 25 by UpdateCount
| project DeviceId, Operation = operationName_s, IoTHub = Resource, UpdateCount, Successes, Failures
content.title: Device Twin Update Activity

content.query:
// Routing failures – messages that failed to route
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DEVICES' and Category == 'Routes'
| where Level == 'Error' or isnotempty(properties_errorMessage_s)
| summarize FailureCount = count() by Resource, operationName_s, properties_endpointName_s, properties_errorMessage_s
| order by FailureCount desc
| project IoTHub = Resource, Operation = operationName_s, Endpoint = properties_endpointName_s, ErrorMessage = properties_errorMessage_s, FailureCount
content.title: Message Routing Failures

content.query:
// D2C and C2D latency from IoT Hub metrics
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {timeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.DEVICES'
| where MetricName in ('d2c.telemetry.ingress.sendThrottle', 'd2c.telemetry.egress.success', 'c2d.methods.success', 'c2d.commands.egress.complete.success')
| summarize
    AvgValue = round(avg(Average), 2),
    MaxValue = round(max(Maximum), 2)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), MetricName, Resource
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: D2C / C2D Metric Trends
